name: ip-inventory
description: Keeps a record of what you have built honest enough to stand behind. Checks every entry against GitHub and your disk, reports what has drifted, and turns the result into the schedule of prior IP you attach to an employment agreement.

interface.shortDescription: Prove what you built, and when
interface.longDescription: An inventory of your own work rots quietly. Repositories get deleted, skills get renamed, paths move, and nothing tells you, so the record you would rely on is wrong at exactly the moment you need it. This checks every entry against GitHub and your filesystem and reports what no longer matches, then turns the surviving record into an exhibit: the schedule of prior intellectual property you attach to an employment agreement so an invention-assignment clause cannot claim it. It reports; it never edits your record without being asked.
defaultPrompt: Check my IP inventory against what actually exists.
Which entries could not go on an IP exhibit yet?
Generate the exhibit of prior IP I own.
